main_text.p: 14. Juramenti illiciti, & juramenti de re illicita discrimen.
main_text.head: SECT. I.
main_text.p: EXpofito fuperiore lectione quid Juramentum in genere, quid in spe-cie promissorium Juramentum, & quid Obligatio: pergendum nunc porrò ad proponendum, quod proximè pollicitus fum, quasdam ὑποθέσεις[?] sive Hypothefes instituto noftro accommodas, velut fundamenta, aut (si malitis) Canones & [illegible, ~8 letters] totius futurae difquisitionis: e quibus sc. petendae sunt, & ad quas exigendae, plerorumque dubiorum determinationes. Sed unum vos interim, antequam id faciam, non jam exoratum eo, (quod facerem si aut suspecta mihi esset vestra humanitas, aut res ipsa non est multo justissima :) sed praemonitos tantum velim; mihi constitutum esse, dum reperiam quod rei de qua agitur utcunque significandae sufficiat, de-verbis non ultra laborare, multo minus de sermonis puritate, nedum elegantia follicitum esse. Curent ista scilicet, qui-bus vacat, & cordi est, negotium fa-cessere

page.notes: The narrow strip of margin text at the right edge is cropped and cannot be read; it is not transcribed. The Greek word after "Canones &" is not legible letter by letter. The Greek word after "quasdam" is uncertain. The numbered theses at the top are transcribed as paragraphs, not headings. The catchword "cessere" is the completion of "fa-" at the line end. A small mark at the left of the catchword line is not transcribed.
